evidence.observation: Pressure steady at ~3.02-3.05 Torr through ramp and early growth at 100 sccm Ar
Pressure rose monotonically 3.048→3.128→3.236→3.321→3.379→3.486 Torr from t=2640-3240 s
Ar flow held at setpoint (~99-100 sccm), so the rise is not caused by more gas coming in
Exhaust O2 stayed low (4-6 ppm), so there is no sign of air getting in, which argues against a seal leak
Temperature holding at 750 °C with stable heater power, so the thermocouple and heater look normal

args.missing_evidence: No reference ranges yet for the growth-stage pressure. To confirm a blockage, check the exhaust line and the downstream pressure/pump, or briefly change the Ar flow and see whether the pressure responds.
